content.short: RabbitHole is a Web3 learn-to-earn platform on Mantle that rewards users with tokens for completing on-chain tasks and learning DeFi protocols.
content.description: RabbitHole is a decentralized user acquisition and education platform that rewards users for completing on-chain tasks and learning to use DeFi protocols. Unlike traditional quest platforms, RabbitHole verifies skill and genuine usage through on-chain activity analysis rather than simple task completion. Users build a verifiable on-chain credential (their RabbitHole profile) that proves their DeFi competence to protocols. The platform supports Mantle, enabling Mantle ecosystem projects to distribute tokens to educated, active users.
